route: Some Couples Have No Responsible Adult - Dance Floor Version
raw_problem: A generic 'no responsible adult' idea could become a loose meme list without story evidence.

repairs.repair: Anchor the whole deck in one sangeet/function dance-floor misstep.
He frees the fabric on beat, then she pulls him into the ridiculous step; both are implicated.
Her expressiveness creates the story, but the payoff is that he joins her rhythm rather than correcting it.
Use Card 16 and Stage-Scene Gate: snag, pause, eye-line, hand movement, spin, shared off-beat ending before final text.
